title: UEFA and 55 associations boycott FIFA competitions
summary: UEFA and its 55 national associations have announced they will not participate in FIFA competitions, citing governance concerns and investor influence. This represents a major rift in international football governance, potentially leading to competing tournaments and reshaping the sport&\#x27;s global structure. The boycott stems from FIFA&\#x27;s plans to expand the World Cup to 48 or even 64 teams and allow external investors ownership in competitions.
context: FIFA is the global governing body for football, while UEFA governs European football. Historically, UEFA has been a powerful bloc within FIFA. Recent FIFA proposals have raised concerns about corruption and commercial overreach.
discussion: The Hacker News community expresses strong support for UEFA&\#x27;s stance, with many calling for the removal of FIFA President Infantino. Commenters worry that external investment will turn football into a pure business.
